caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles a lamp base or a candlestick, rendered in pencil or graphite on a plain, light-colored background. The object consists of a wide, circular base with a rounded edge, supporting a tall, slender, and curvilinear central column that transitions into a cylindrical upper section with a smaller, slightly conical top and a short cylindrical extension or fitting at the very top. The surfaces are shaded to suggest a metallic or glossy material, showing light reflection and shadowing. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified outline sketch of the same object, contained within its own rectangular border. The whole composition is enclosed within a faint rectangular border and a small artist's signature is visible in the lower left corner. The overall color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of gray produced by the pencil on off-white or beige paper.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
